parameters.name: Bucket
parameters.description: The bucket of the data cache.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. The value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: DataCacheId
parameters.description: The ID of the data cache.

parameters.name: DestinationRegionId
parameters.description: The destination region to which the data cache is copied.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the data cache.

parameters.name: Path
parameters.description: The path of the data cache.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the existing data cache resides.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group to which the data cache belongs.

parameters.name: RetentionDays
parameters.description: The number of days to retain the data cache.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of data cache tags.
